answer: An operator that abandons 73 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the nectar forfeiture shows up in the pulse totals with the canyon audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 44% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
